title: Cut paper
when: Title sequences, openers, podcast and series intros, posters in motion: bold flat shapes in rhythm
rules: Flat shapes in two or three colours: no gradients, glows or lens effects. The edge of a cut is the texture.

Shapes become each other across cuts (the same element id in consecutive canvas beats morphs): a disc becomes a bar, which becomes a door, which becomes the light through it. Continuity is the whole grammar.
Type is condensed caps with wide tracking, set into the composition like another shape (run it up a panel, cut it into a wall), never as a caption.
Credits are complete: every role has its name. Without names, use complete lines (a season, the day it airs) rather than an empty role.
Cut on the music: every beat is one move and one hold. End the morphs on the title, then change the grammar once for the button (a panel wipe).
